name: Forest
desc: Dense woodland. Lumber yards cut more; track costs extra clearing.

name: Desert
desc: Hot and dry. Quarries dig more, pumps find little water, steam engines drink more.

name: Taiga
desc: Cold conifer country. Lumber and pumps do well, farms poorly; trains run a little slower.

name: Swamp
desc: Wet lowland. Pumps overflow; track needs an embankment and trains crawl.

name: Ocean
desc: Open water with the odd island. Pumps do well on the shore.

name: Lake
desc: Still water filling a basin. Pumps draw well; bridges only.

name: River
desc: Running water from the hills to a lake or the sea. Pumps draw well; bridges cross it.

name: Beach
desc: Sand on the sea shore. Quarries find little; pumps get salt water.

name: Mountain
desc: Bare rock, snow and glacier ice high up. Quarries dig more; track costs more and trains climb slower; pumps find little.
